answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing: that a changed record whose working bytes hash to no journal last_sha was not written through the door; the door journals every write it makes, so a door write always matches. Also that PostToolUse exit 2 feeds stderr to Claude (the hook API contract artifactgate's docstring records for PreToolUse; measured at build with a scratch hook run).
answers.builder_check: A Haiku builder needs: verdict(tool_name, tool_input) is the PreToolUse judge; the PostToolUse stdin carries hook_event_name 'PostToolUse'; door.roots(), door.locate(path), door.read_journal(root), door.last_sha(entries, rel), door._sha(bytes) answer the record and journal questions; door.set_diagnostic_roots(roots) points them at a scratch tree for the proof; git status --porcelain per root lists changed paths. The ticket's how and outcomes name each.

answers.collision_check: Against artifactgate's co-occurrence trade (its docstring): not a collision; PreToolUse keeps refusing what it sees and this measures what it cannot. Against check_staged: same question, earlier; the commit check stays the physics.
answers.falsifier_check: Falsifier: a scratch-commons ticket written by a script file run from Bash is allowed by PreToolUse and named by PostToolUse; artifact.write of the same record and a dirty non-record are not named; .claude/settings.json registers artifactgate under PostToolUse for Bash. Horizon: the proof, sealed.
